rows.en:
(I came to Griffith Park, but there's
nothing much to do. I'm bored...)

(I came to Griffith Park, but there's
nothing much to do. I'm bored...)

(So, I came to Deep Akihabara,
but what should I do?)
rows.notes: x4, both genders. Deep Akihabara is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
Hm? If it isn't \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?

Oh, Klan-senpai. I was bored,
so I'm just wandering around.
What are you doing here, Klan-senpai?
M-me?!

W-well, you see...
I just remembered something I have to do.
See you!
rows.notes: x8. Wording of 'just remembered' as c01418.

rows.en: Huh? Oh, okay. See you...

(She ran off like she was fleeing...
What on earth was she doing?)
(Hmm, now I'm curious...)

(She ran off like she was fleeing...
What on earth was she doing?)
(Hmm, now I'm really curious...)

(So, I came to the Observation Pier,
but what should I do?)

(Klan-senpai and I promised to have tea
at Silver Moon today, but...)
(Klan-senpai's late...)
(Hm? A call from Klan-senpai...)
Hello, this is \p.

Sorry, \p!
I suddenly got called in to my part-time job,
so I don't think I can make it.

Oh, your part-time job...
Then it can't be helped.

I'll make it up to you, I promise!
I'm really sorry...

Please don't worry about it.
See you, then...
Yeah, see you.
rows.notes: x12: Klan here (frd_kln_105/106); male player in frd_yui_101/106. Works for both.

rows.en:
(Well, if something urgent came up,
it can't be helped...
Guess I'll head home too.)
(Klan-senpai's late...)

(Well, if something urgent came up,
it can't be helped...
I guess I'll head home too.)

(Klan-senpai and I promised to go shopping
in the Shibuya Area today, but...)

(Klan-senpai and I promised to go shopping
in the Shibuya Area today,
but she's still not here...)

Sorry, \p!
I suddenly got called in to my part-time job,
so I don't think I can make it.
rows.notes: Variant spelling of c08124; same English.

rows.en:
Please don't worry about it.
See you, then...
rows.notes: Variant spelling of c08127; same English.

rows.en:
(Well, if something urgent came up,
I guess it can't be helped...
I'll head home too, then.)

(Klan-senpai and I came to have fun
at the ranch on Island 3, but...)

Wow~ They really are big,
these Zentradi...
rows.notes: x4. Klan admiring the (giant) Zentradi at the ranch; c08139 finds it odd since she is one.

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai's a Zentradi herself,
so it seems kind of wrong for her
to be so impressed...)

\p!
Don't just stand there spacing out!
Let's go play with the hippo-cows!

(At this rate, I can't even tell
which of us is older.)

Mm, we sure played a lot!
That was more fun than I expected!

Well then...
It's getting late, so let's head home.
See you, \p.

(Hanging out with Klan-senpai was
a really nice change of pace today.)
rows.notes: Male (x2). 'change of pace' as finished slices.

rows.en:
(At this rate, I can't even tell
which of us is older.)

(Hanging out with Klan-senpai was
a really nice change of pace today.)

(I invited Klan-senpai to a concert,
but is she even into classical music?)

Thanks for inviting me to the concert today.
And you even got me a ticket...

Oh, it's nothing.
Someone gave me the tickets anyway.

By the way, Klan-senpai,
are you into classical music?

O-of course I am!
It's only natural for a grown woman...

Come on, if we keep chatting, we'll be late.
Let's head into the hall, too.

That's Klan-senpai for you.
True grown woman that you are, you fell
asleep the moment the concert started.

I-it couldn't be helped!
The soothing music just, you know,
lured me off to sleep...
Yes, yes, I get it.

Hmph, next time I definitely won't fall asleep!
Take me again! See you!

(Well, Klan-senpai fell asleep, but...
maybe she enjoyed it in her own way?
Okay, I'll invite her again sometime.)
rows.notes: x4, both genders (no gendered ending in the Japanese).

rows.en:
(I invited Klan-senpai to a concert,
but is she even into classical music?)

Oh, it's nothing.
Someone gave me the tickets anyway.

(Klan-senpai invited me to come have fun
in Deep Akihabara, but...)

All right!
Now, let's try one of these butler cafes!
Follow me, \p!
rows.notes: Both genders. shitsuji kissa = butler cafe.

rows.en:
(Who'd have thought her goal
was going to a butler cafe...)
If you space out, I'll leave you behind!

Ah, wait for me,
Klan-senpai!

Being treated like a young lady like that
isn't half bad, I must say.

Well, if you enjoyed it, Klan-senpai,
then I guess that's fine...

Michel would probably look good
as a butler...
rows.notes: Both genders. Michel as the Japanese says Misheru.

rows.en:
Right, next time I'll force him
into the outfit and...
Huh? Klan-senpai?
N-no, it's nothing!

Well, let's call it a day.
See you!
See you, Klan-senpai...

(Hmm, well, Klan-senpai seemed happy
at least, so I guess it was fine?)

(Hmm, well, Klan-senpai seemed happy
at least, so I guess it was fine?)

(Klan-senpai invited me to come have fun
in Deep Akihabara, but...)
rows.notes: Both genders; line-break variant of c08161.

rows.en: All right! We're going to a butler cafe!!
(So the butler cafe was her goal after all.)

If you want to go, Klan-senpai,
I won't stop you, but...
Then let's get going!
rows.notes: x4: Klan here, Pinon in frd_pnn_109.

rows.en: Man~, that was fun...
rows.notes: x6: Klan here, Pinon in frd_pnn_109.

rows.en: I'm just glad you enjoyed it, Klan-senpai...
All right! We're coming back again!

(Klan-senpai...
She really fell for butler cafes, huh.)
(So the butler cafe was her goal after all.)

(Klan-senpai...
She really fell for butler cafes, huh.)

uncertain: c08109/c08161/c08176 use Deep Akihabara, which is provisional in locations.json.
c08138: Klan marvels at how big 'the Zentradi' are at the Island 3 ranch (presumably the macronized Zentradi ranch hands); the player finds it odd since she is one (c08139). Referent inferred.
c08128 'Yeah, see you.' also serves the male player in frd_yui_101/106.
c08149 warui na rendered as thanks; c08154 kept sarcastic.
